summary: browser-use publishes two benchmarks of its own, both run outside this repository. On Stealth Bench V2 (100 bot-protected sites, 2 visits each), Browser Use Cloud got through on 90.5% of visits against Anchor 82%, Kernel 80.5% and Browserbase 78.5%, and CLOUD.md:26 states that the sites were picked because Browser Use Cloud historically got through where stock Chrome with a US proxy did not, so they are not a balanced sample. The BU Bench V2 chart in the README (a 60-task subset) is a JPEG that prints one score, 77.3% for GPT-6 ASTRA, and plots the other models without printed values. The runner and logs are in a separate repository (github.com/browser-use/benchmark), PR evaluations are sent to an eval platform whose URL and key are GitHub secrets (.github/workflows/eval-on-pr.yml:35-36), and tests/agent_tasks/README.md points to tests/ci/test_agent_real_tasks.py, which is not in the repository, so none of these numbers can be reproduced from this clone.
result_focus_note: manual classification of published_results: outcome = does the tool do its job; engineering = speed of the software itself
